Name: More Dachshund Dogs
Author: suzukiPC
Description:
A little pet mod for dachshund lovers like me! Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7224]athalie's Dachshund Dog mod[/url] I went in and enhanced their sprites, and optimized it for 1.6! And now, instead of replacing a vanilla dog's texture, you can have these doxies as their own self, AND even adopt more** ! 

[i]**After fulfilling certain conditions in-game, it is tied to a new mechanic that came out in 1.6 :D

[/i]It's my first time making a pet mod, let me know if any issues arise! I hope you enjoy :)

[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/how-to-install2.png[/img]
﻿
[b]1)[/b] Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[b]2)[/b] Download the file and unzip it; extract it into your Mods folder


[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/features.png[/img]

✨ 5 dachshund dog variants at the start of character create
✨ Hotdog costume toggle for each variant in Generic Mod Config Menu :D
✨ Adoptability at Marnie's shop when you unlock Pet License
✨ Configurable price range (Full Price, Half-off, Big Sale!)
[list]
[*]Adjust with Generic Mod Config Menu :) its default setting is Full Price
[/list]
